text:
Samir Patel: Handoff check-in — I'm taking primary for the next 8 hours (US‑EAST). Aisha you're secondary; please confirm you can take pages for database and routing tickets.

Aisha Johnson: Confirmed. I'll be on-call for DB and routing. I have a planned short break 02:15–02:30 UTC, Jordan you okay to cover pager during that 15m?

Jordan Kim: Yep I can cover that 02:15 slot. I'll keep my phone on vibrate.

Samir Patel: Excellent. Two quick notes before I go offline for dinner at 23:10 UTC:
1) Recent spike in prefix-cache misses — see console alerts from last 6 hours.
2) There is a partially mitigated routing flapper in us-east-1 that might reappearing during high traffic.

Nora Li: Added runbook pointers to the thread. If paging for "high token latency" or "prefix cache miss rate" follow runbook 'cache-regions/fallback-and-warmcache'. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/cache-regions#warmcache (useful snippet below).

Nora Li: ```
Quick mitigation:
1) Promote warm cache snapshot: /runbook warm-cache promote --region us-east-1 --snapshot recent
2) If promote fails, route to backup model variant: /route set --model rdl-7b-int8 --region us-east-1 --policy fallback
3) If error persists > 5m, escalate to SRE lead and open incident bridge.
```

incident-bot: Pager triggered: HIGH latency — prefix cache miss rate > 12% (us-east-1). Severity: P2. Incident ID: INC-2026-1392.

Aisha Johnson: I'm on the page. Triage: checking cache autoscaler and snapshot promotion logs.

Samir Patel: If promotion doesn't fix within 4 minutes, page on-call-sre (pager group) and add SRE lead. Escalation matrix I use:
- P1 (customer-facing degradation, multiple regions): immediate page to on-call-sre AND SRE lead (@Nora Li).
- P2 (single-region, increased latency): page on-call-sre; if no ack in 5m escalate to SRE lead.
- P3 (non-urgent error spike): track in channel and open ticket for next shift.

Aisha Johnson: Promotion started, logs: "snapshot promote started: id=prom-983". Latency dropping slightly.

Jordan Kim: Watchdog says token latency trending down to baseline. If it stabilizes >10m mark, we close.

Aisha Johnson: Stabilized at 8m. I'll keep an eye for residual errors.

Samir Patel: Good. Reminder for the break coverage: Jordan you'll take any pages during 02:15–02:30 UTC, escalate per the matrix above. Also leave an executor note in incident tracker if you take actions.

Jordan Kim: Copy that. One operational caveat: Pager on-call-sre only alerts primary SRE; if wide‑scale blips hit multiple customers, use manual broadcast to #incidents-ops and add the on-call paging rule to include SRE lead.

Nora Li: Adding explicit contact points here: Primary SRE on-call: on-call-sre (rotating). SRE lead (escalate after timeouts): Nora Li. Platform eng alpha: Samir Patel. Routing pager: routing-pager (for BGP/region routing). DB pager: db-oncall.

Aisha Johnson: Noted. Also a quick escalation checklist for whoever is paged:
- Confirm scope (region/customer-impact)
- Attempt quick mitigation (warm cache promote / route fallback)
- If mitigation fails after 5m or customer impact > 1h, open bridge: /bridge open --incident INC-XXXX --severity P1
- Notify Customer Success if >30 customers impacted or SPOC flagged.

Samir Patel: I'm going to leave a handoff summary in the oncall rotation tool. Key items I'll include: current mitigations (warm cache promoted), residual risk (routing flapper intermittent), break coverage (Jordan 02:15–02:30 UTC), escalation path, runbook links.

oncall-rotations: Handoff recorded: primary=Samir Patel until 06:00 UTC, secondary=Aisha Johnson, temp cover Jordan Kim 02:15–02:30 UTC.

Aisha Johnson: One last thing — if you get a page with signature "model OOM" route to db-oncall first, then page on-call-sre only if OOM is causing customer impact (requests failing).

Samir Patel: Good call. Also, when opening a bridge, please include token-level snapshots (last 10m) and sampling of failing requests. Saved command:
```
/collect tokens --since 10m --sample 50 --out /tmp/tokens-dump.json
/bridge open --incident INC-2026-1392 --owners @on-call-sre,@Nora Li
```

Aisha Johnson: Closing the loop — I'll tag Customer Success if we see reappearance. For now marking incident INC-2026-1392 as mitigated and keeping monitor for 30m.

Samir Patel: Thanks team. If anything changes ping me directly. I'm signing off for dinner. :thumbsup:

Jordan Kim: Thanks, have a good dinner. I'll cover the short break and mute non-critical notifications.

Nora Li: Great handoff. Keeping an eye from SRE lead perspective, will jump in only if escalation rules hit.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1392 status updated: MITIGATED -> MONITORING.

Aisha Johnson: Final: monitoring window started at 23:08 UTC. If no regression by 23:38 UTC we close.

Samir Patel: End of thread — handoff complete.
